PID5_abort.interpretation: Valid solves arrived late for20ms selection; stale-tick guard latched2rad/s EmergencyLanding. Actualheight rose past1.5m despite downward vertical acceleration demand; nativePID fault-free. Underlying vertical-response cause awaits measuredRPM/mixer data, not unused INDI shadow fields.

configuration.commissioning: Explicit matched MPC+PID benchmark; lemniscate, indi_shaped_angular,radius2.0m,6eightlaps,peak3.0m/s. Common measured mass, geometry, command bounds and envelope; INDI uses identified prediction dynamics, PID uses ideal-rate dynamics with a separate causal selected-command delay projection; takeoff differs: INDI0.4weight ground warmup then immediate climb on guarded ACK, bounded1.2weight launch floor for at most0.5s with3N/s upward slew until confirmed liftoff; PID retains0.4weight and legacy timing with boost disabled. Circle centeredworldXY[0,0] starts[0,-R]; lemniscate startsworldcenter. Ground supplied by caller: physical launcher must obtain a fresh stationary disabled-bench capture before flight. limits.pid_only=false selects the common permission-ON guarded protocol; inner_controller and actual native FC ACK determine inner identity. BUTTERFLY: 3 cycles, 6 complete eight laps, alternating +h/-h planes with h=0.3m; each eight stops at center with zeroV/A/J.  Explicit width_m=3; footprint4x3m. Explicit reference acceleration/jerk shaping lengthens phase ramps for the selected geometry and peak speed. Mocap coverage is not established by reference shaping. PID COMPARISON: native PID is confirmed before arming and throughout healthy phases; INDI is never requested. Ideal-rate MPC projects to the20ms selection plus15ms output epoch from accepted measured state and selected command history, without identified INDI poles. Emergency2rad/s is explicit for3/4/5; ordinary takeoff and settled landing retain0.6rad/s. HIGH-SPEED PREPARATION: reference bounds explicitly increased to preserve requested peak and two-second ramps; reference screen is not flight qualification.

PID_native.scope:
PID native measurements only: gyro, actual RPM and applied mixer counts.
INDI-shadow allocator/omega-target/servo/residual/desired-alpha/torque fields
are not treated as PID actuation. No measured filtering, resampling or shifts.
Nominal kT sum(omega^2) is a model thrust estimate, not a force measurement.
